about: Domaine LeSeurre is the work of Sébastien and Céline LeSeurre, a French couple who brought Old World training to Keuka Lake. Sébastien is a sixth-generation winemaker from a Champagne family, with degrees in viticulture, oenology and wine marketing; Céline grew up among family vineyards in southwest France. After some fifteen vintages across France, Australia, New Zealand and the United States, they settled in the Finger Lakes in 2011, made their first wine in 2012 and opened their tasting room on the east side of Keuka Lake in 2013.

Rather than rely on a single vineyard, the LeSeurres work with growers across the region, tasting the grapes every couple of days and picking by flavour rather than by numbers alone. They blend lots from different soils, slate and shale for minerality and acidity, clay for fruit, which Sébastien likens to an orchestra rather than a single musician. Their whites typically rest a year on the lees and another in bottle before release. The Cuvée Classique Gewürztraminer is a floral, juicy expression of the grape, with orchard fruit, spice and a mineral finish.
facts: About one year on the lees, one year in bottle
